title: KFC Wizard and Clock Flowers
description: A surreal night scene shows a bearded wizard in a star-patterned robe holding a leaking KFC bucket that drips blue liquid. Above him, a large green plant grows two clock-faced flower heads with melting faces and tears, struck by a white lightning bolt. The ground is covered with smaller clock flowers in KFC buckets. The background features a swirling cosmic sky with stars and white petals falling.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a bearded wizard in a grey star-covered robe standing in a grassy field at night, holding a leaking KFC bucket that drips blue liquid. Multiple smaller clock-faced flowers grow from KFC buckets on the ground. Swirling cosmic starry sky with green and blue vortex patterns and falling white petals.
